about: Analyst questions for the filings tools, answered from the companies' own filings. dev: companies and releases the tools were built on; fresh: releases never used while building or tuning them. Truths are independent of the tools: statement figures from SEC's companyfacts XBRL API (truth.py), table figures from the raw document by a separate parser (truth.py), guidance from the release's own words (source_quote, read by hand). None of these companies or periods is one of the Vals.ai Finance Agent public questions read on 2026-10-14. fresh-2: a second set of releases, run once after the fixes the fresh set prompted, to check that they generalize; not tuned on. verify: claims for verify_claims built from SEC companyfacts by a separate script (true figures, last year's figure claimed for this year, unit slips, a quarter claimed for the year, future years, dividends from companies that pay none, a non-GAAP figure); pass = the expected verdict and, for a contradicted claim, the expected diagnosis. trap: questions with false premises (a year not reported, a company that does not exist, a table no filing has, a release that does not exist, a dividend never paid); pass = a refusal or an empty answer, never a figure.
scoring: A question passes when the tool's answer holds every expected figure: values in any scale the page uses (thousands, millions, billions), a range as one row with both ends, a comparison as the row with the expected position. Tool level only: no model reads the answers.
